def VTask.memPartition {α : Type*} (f : ℕ → Set α) (n : ℕ) : Set (Set α) :=
  let refineStep : (Set (Set α)) → ℕ → Set (Set α) := fun partitions i =>
    partitions.biUnion (fun s => {s ∩ f i, s \ f i})
  Nat.recOn n {Set.univ} (fun i partitions => refineStep partitions i)
